peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
/var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-i0xKfE/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says retry design is undecided. charge currently creates HttpClient per call, posts /charges, and throws for HTTP >=500. I need your client/queue decision before writing the short plan; please also specify any retry/idempotency constraints.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on client versus queue retries before writing the plan.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says retry design is undecided. charge currently creates HttpClient per call, posts /charges, and throws for HTTP >=500. I need your client/queue decision before writing the short plan; please also specify any retry/idempotency constraints.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: retries belong in the queue, per the architect; the shared client and batch path remain single-attempt.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Per the architect, implement retries in the queue, not the shared client, so the batch path remains single-attempt. Keep charge() in src/payments.ts single-attempt and expose failures for queue classification. Add bounded queue retries with exponential backoff and jitter for transient failures; do not retry permanent failures. Before enabling retries, verify payment-provider idempotency support and preserve one idempotency key across attempts to prevent duplicate charges. Test retry limits, transient versus permanent failures, idempotency, and that the batch path never retries."}
